info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Status API provides information on the current status of education enrollments within the system. It allows users to retrieve comprehensive details about various enrollment records, including their states, timestamps, and associated educational programs. This API is particularly useful for administrators and education management systems that need to monitor enrollment activity and assess program participation. By leveraging this endpoint, developers can integrate enrollment status data into their applications for real-time insights and reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current enrollment status for a specific user or program. Use this to keep users informed about their application progress.

requestBody.description: This endpoint retrieves the status of enrollments. The request body should contain details for the specific status check.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of enrollments.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on enrollment status. It specifies the format and type of the expected input data.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusResponse_2.title: Enrollment Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the enrollment operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the enrollment.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the enrollment operation.

state.description: The current state of the enrollment operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the enrollment request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the status of the operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the enrollment process.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusResponse_2.description: Schema representing the response of the GET Enrollment Status API. This response contains information about the status of the enrollment operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the enrollment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the enrollment was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the enrollment process was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information about the enrollment process.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A lower value indicates a faster response time.
